coverfile.description: Path to the cover file (image/audio) to embed data into. Required for embed command.

embedfile.description: Path to the secret file to embed. Use '-' for stdin. Required for embed command.

stegofile.description: Path for the resulting stego file.

extractfile.description: Path to save extracted data. Overrides embedded filename. Leave empty to use embedded name.

passphrase.description: Passphrase for encryption. Leave empty in config files; inject at runtime for security.

encryption.description: Encryption algorithm and mode. Use 'none' to disable.

compression_level.description: Compression level 1 (fastest) to 9 (best). Ignored if dontcompress is true.

no_checksum.description: If true, do not embed CRC32 checksum.

dontembedname.description: If true, do not embed the original secret file's name.

verbose.description: If true, display detailed status information.

force.description: If true, overwrite existing files without asking.

quiet.description: If true, suppress information messages. Overrides verbose.

command.description: steghide command to execute: embed or extract.
